# Taiga Ikedo

Taiga Ikedo is a PhD candidate in Japanese linguistics at Stanford University. From the perspective of linguistic anthropology, he studies how notions of appropriateness and communicative competence are interpreted, evaluated, and negotiated in contemporary Japanese discourse.
